arguments.Title: 정류소 배치 검증 및 미리보기
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var root=GameObject.Find("Stop shelters | visual only"); if(root==null) throw new System.Exception("Shelters missing"); result.Log("shelters="+root.transform.childCount+" colliders="+root.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>(true).Length); Transform target=root.transform.GetChild(0); foreach(Transform t in root.transform) if(t.name.StartsWith("library_road_candidate")) target=t; Selection.activeGameObject=target.gameObject; SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.LookAt(target.position+Vector3.up*1.3f,Quaternion.Euler(18,target.eulerAngles.y+160,0),5,false,true); result.Log("position="+target.position+" dirty="+SceneManager.GetActiveScene().isDirty); } }
